# mockware

Generate mock/stub SDK layers for embedded unit testing.
Scans project source → auto-detects missing external SDK headers
from #include directives → generates stub headers with
function-pointer overrides for test-time replacement.

## CLI reference

### `mockware scan <project_path>`

Auto-detect missing external SDK dependencies.

```
  -o, --output FILE             Output YAML path (default: missing_apis.yml)
  --mode [full|partial]         full=scratch, partial=merge (default: partial)
  --existing FILE               Existing YAML to merge into (for --mode partial)
  -I, --include-dir DIR         Extra include-search directories
  --include PATTERN             Source glob patterns (repeatable)
  --exclude PATTERN             Exclude glob patterns (repeatable)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output
```

Produces 6-section YAML: headers, types, macros, enums, structs, functions.
Project-internal symbols are auto-filtered via scan_project_symbols().
Use --exclude to skip generated SDK dirs (mock-sdk/**).

### `mockware parse <project_path>`

Alias for `scan` — identical behaviour.

### `mockware generate`

Generate mock SDK stubs from a YAML knowledge base.

```
  -p, --project DIR   Root of project source tree (required)
  -i, --input FILE    YAML input from scan/parse (required)
  -o, --output DIR    Output directory for mock SDK tree (required)
  --custom-impl DIR   User-provided .c implementation overrides
  -v, --verbose       Verbose output
```

## YAML format

```yaml
headers:       {path: {includes: [dependency, ...]}}
types:         {name: underlying_type_string}
macros:        {name: value_string}
               # value starting with '(' → function-like (no space in #define)
enums:         {name: {values: {member: int_or_str, ...}}}
structs:       {name: {definition: "typedef struct { ... } name;"}}
functions:     {name: {return:, params: [typed_param, ...],
                       header:, body:, kind:}}
```

Function fields: return (default void), params (list with types),
header (path for attribution → source/<path>.c; missing → general.c),
body (custom stub body), kind ("inline" for static inline).

## Generated tree

```
output/
├── CMakeLists.txt          → builds as mock_sdk
├── include/
│   ├── <header>.h          → per-header stub (defs + function decls)
│   └── mockware/
│       ├── types.h         → typedefs + auto-detected std includes
│       ├── macros.h        → #define macros
│       ├── enums.h         → enum defs
│       ├── structs.h       → struct defs
│       └── fakes.h         → extern function-pointer declarations
└── source/
    ├── <header>.c          → per-header impl
    └── general.c           → untagged function impls
```

## Key patterns

### Function-pointer override

Each generated function `foo`:
- `foo_default()` — default impl (return 0/NULL/empty)
- `foo_mock` — overridable function pointer
- `foo()` — delegates to `_mock`

Tests include `mockware/fakes.h` to get `extern` `_mock` declarations.

### Function-like macros

YAML `MACRO: (x) value` → `#define MACRO(x) value` (no space).
Standard for FreeRTOS-style macros like `pdMS_TO_TICKS`.

### Standard type includes

Generator scans YAML for uint64_t, size_t, bool, FILE, etc. and
auto-adds #include <stdint.h>, <stddef.h>, etc. to mockware/types.h.

### Merge workflow

```bash
mockware scan . -o apis.yml                     # first scan
# edit apis.yml ...
mockware scan . --existing apis.yml --mode partial \  # re-scan merges
    --exclude "mock-sdk/**"
mockware generate --project . -i apis.yml -o mock-sdk  # regenerate
```
